scope.owned_layer: Live supervisor provider readiness and dispatch evidence for the Claude and Antigravity families.
scope.not_changing: Provider configuration, provider credentials, scheduler policy, task ownership, product services, hosted FE/BFF deployment, and twelve-loop product maturity.

provider_probes.probe_semantics: Targeted probe_provider_auth(config, provider_id, force=True) calls from the validated live command root. Cached provider capability rows are not used as the readiness verdict.

antigravity.error: Antigravity account quota is exhausted; enable overages or wait for reset.

claude_worker.proves: A real supervisor worker started on a Claude lane after provider readiness recovery.

dispatch_proof.fleet_verdict: Claude provider-first dispatch is proven. Antigravity remains unavailable without blocking healthy supervisor-admitted lanes.

antigravity_dispatch_pause.reason: Antigravity primary and fallback model quotas are exhausted.

acceptance.criterion: Run current Claude and Antigravity readiness probes without editing .orchestrator/config.json.
acceptance.proof: provider_probes records forced live probes for both primary providers; task and command roots report no .orchestrator/config.json diff.

acceptance.criterion: If healthy, prove at least one real supervisor worker starts on a Claude or Antigravity lane.
acceptance.proof: dispatch_proof.claude_worker binds a live supervisor queue event, run id, provider slot, L12 task, and heartbeat.

acceptance.criterion: If not healthy, record fail-closed provider facts and keep healthy supervisor workers draining L12 tasks.
acceptance.proof: Antigravity quota failure and provider-scoped pause are recorded while three additional Codex-family L12 workers remain live.

commands.command: python3 -c '<load live config; probe_provider_auth for claude and antigravity with force=True; emit sanitized fields>'
commands.conclusion: Claude live probe ready; Antigravity live probe quota_reached and fail-closed.
healthy=true; supervisor heartbeat, lifecycle, watchdog, and authoritative task-state shadow checks passed.
One live Claude L12 worker plus three live Codex-family L12 workers; Antigravity retained a quota-terminal provider pause.
No provider config edit in either the validated command root or task worktree.

commands.command: PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.orchestrator" "$TASK_PY" -m pytest -q <six targeted Claude/Antigravity probe-gate tests in .orchestrator/test_provider_permissions.py>
commands.conclusion: 6 passed in 0.62s: forced launch probes bypass cache, Claude refresh is preserved, Antigravity dual-model quota fails closed, and credential/quota aliases share capacity.

commands.command: PYTHONPATH="$PWD/.orchestrator" "$TASK_PY" -m pytest -q <three Claude/Antigravity lane and fallback-routing tests in .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py>
commands.conclusion: 3 passed in 0.55s: Claude lane/account limits, primary Antigravity admission, and healthy fallback routing remain enforced.

known_limitations: Antigravity remains unavailable until quota becomes available and a later fresh targeted probe succeeds.
This evidence proves a Claude worker start and live heartbeat, not the terminal correctness of the separate task that worker is reviewing.
Provider readiness and fleet dispatch do not by themselves prove twelve-loop product completion.

record_log.reference: Fresh targeted provider probes, supervisor runtime health, live Claude worker dispatch, Antigravity fail-closed pause, and continuing L12 worker snapshot.
